channel.title: 20 Blok
channel.description: Culture, creativity, and the internet. Twenty stories every issue by Lenny Lesser.

item.title: STRAIGHT UP: Retail Mindset
item.description: When we talk about “retail” in financial news, we mean the crowd: the average Jill and Joe putting their money into the markets.

item.title: MUST-SEE: Maeve Halligan Swims Upstream at Cambridge
item.description: Maeve Halligan may represent more than she realizes. In under 12 minutes at the Cambridge Union this May, she became the face of what could be an inflection point in the gender war Western society has created.

item.title: INDUSTRY FREEKS: Taavi.TV: The Artist Whisperer
item.description: Taavi is a spiritual guide, a creative’s best friend and a mentor all in one. Every day on his channel, he takes on doubt, momentum and energy—the things that stand between your creative side and the work you want to make.

item.title: NEWSFEED: Should We Talk About Lindsay Clancy? (Prob Not)
item.description: I'm starting to think that when something doesn't align with an ideology we're emotionally attached to, we narcissistically search for a way to excuse it.

item.title: WORD MEME: I Turned It Down ↔ I Turnt It Down
item.description: Big Boogie is an American rapper. He has more than a million followers on Instagram and is well established in his own right.

item.title: TOOLZ: Don’t Sleep💤 on Grok
item.description: What it does: Grok is xAI’s answer to ChatGPT, with one major advantage: it’s built directly into X. It searches the web and X in real time and makes images and short videos.

item.title: BEHIND THE REEL: Gen X-Era Advice Gone Way Wrong
item.description: The sad part is that "follow your passion," "just be yourself" and "money can't buy happiness" all contain some truth. The problem is that we forget to deliver those messages in context and accurately.

item.title: FIND YOUR EDGE: It’s Not Time, It’s Pace
item.description: This clip by Charlie Jabaley, known as Charlie Rocket, is for anyone who feels like they’re trying to use every second of every day but gets tired and can’t fit it all in. We forget to be audacious and just let it rip.

item.title: STYLE SCENE: Jean Phil, the Best-Dressed Fighter in Paris
item.description: Picture a Parisian street. A man in a baggy houndstooth suit and a knotted tie, with a vogued ’70s bob, a curled handlebar mustache, and a neck a little too long. He doesn’t say a word. Then the music hits, hip-hop and gangster rap, and he squares up and starts shadowboxing at nobody.

item.title: UNDERGROUND: Harry Mack IYKYK
item.description: Harry Mack is a freestyle specialist: he improvises words over hip-hop beats, on the spot. He’s been doing it a long time, and it’s safe to say he’s famous. Still, a lot of people don’t know who he is.

item.title: DEZIGN UR RITUAL: Fragrance Part III: Niche Edition
item.description: Fragrance 101 got you started. Part 2 took one step forward. This time, we go niche.

item.title: CHAIN REACTION: We Need to Talk About Bitcoin (Not What You Think)
item.description: Somewhere along the way, the Bitcoin crowd lost the plot.

item.title: LOLZ: It’s Been a (Ryan) Long Time Coming
item.description: I remember watching a COVID-era Ryan Long sketch before I even knew his name. He was in the melee of creators breaking through online back then, and I lost track of him before I ever latched on. Not this time. He's back in my sphere, and I couldn't be happier with his earnest irony.

item.title: MUSIC FLOW: Moderator, “When I Dream”
item.description: From his 2018 album Sinner’s Syndrome, this one is laid-back trip-hop, and I get ’90s electronic, Tarantino, country, futuristic cowboy vibes. Enjoy.

item.title: STORY BEAT: Knowing with Tejiri
item.description: From my documentary photo series, Search for Story.

item.title: OFF THE PATH: The Psychology of People Who Refuse Tattoos
item.description: A great example of something contrarian and rebellious turning into the status quo.

item.title: WALL OF SOMMI: The Chart Nobody is Talking About
item.description: Sommi contends the Bitcoin dominance chart is flashing overbought, and that everybody’s already in. Why is no one talking about it?

item.title: SPORTS TALK: The Foul Heard ‘Round the WNBA
item.description: Banging someone’s head in on a basketball play, getting ejected, and posting “WHITE PRIVILEGE” online while still in the locker room is truly wild.

item.title: NOW PLAYING: The Devil Wears Prada 2
item.description: Prada 2 hit all the right notes: top-tier performances, a storyline about working in the fashion and beauty industries, well written, great locations—all-around very well done. Lady Gaga is even in it. It’s the perfect mix of quality and entertainment. If you let go and have fun with it, it is…

item.title: BASED: Banksy Makes a Statement (Again)
item.description: From the time he dropped on the scene to Exit Through the Gift Shop and beyond, it's been hard to know what's real with Banksy. He lives in the shadows, and it's hard to believe one person pulls all this off. Is it a media stunt? Who's really in on it?
